name: Synthetic clinical cohort

phases.title: Transfer baseline
phases.description: Compare lossless formats and delivery costs.

phases.title: Feature selection
phases.description: Review missingness and preserve clinical predictors.

phases.title: PCA & autoencoder
phases.description: Build reduced representations and portable payloads.

phases.title: Utility evaluation
phases.description: Measure reconstruction, retention and neighborhood overlap.

phases.title: Verified delivery
phases.description: Package, verify and benchmark each configuration.
